# Experimental Design

The aim of this experiment is to investigate how toxic cyanobacteria affect the multidimensionality of the predator *Chaoborus* via changes in its prey (Figure 1-2). This is realistic in nature compared to the percentage of biomass made out of cyanobacteria (ref) (bloom defined as > 50% of biomass constituted by cyanobacteria, Molot et al., 2014).
